data.narrative:
Until, a Series A biotech company led by Laura Deming and Hunter Davis, has raised $106M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Only one valuation method proved applicable given available data. Stage-Progression analysis uses Until's $106M total raised as a baseline and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage progression, yielding $212M. This represents the primary quantitative anchor. Peer-Median analysis was not viable: while 7 same-sector peers exist, fewer than 3 met narrow stage and valuation-tier filters needed for statistical reliability. Public-Comp anchoring using the sector's 6.2x P/S median could not be applied due to absence of revenue disclosure for the private target.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $180M to $244M, centered on $212M. This range reflects conservative ($180M, -15% variance) to optimistic ($244M, +15% variance) interpretations of the single applicable method. Key uncertainties include Until's actual revenue trajectory and cash-burn profile, neither disclosed here, which would materially refine any public-comparable anchoring. The limited methodological convergence underscores the difficulty of private-stage biotech valuation absent revenue or clinical-stage specifics.
